title: SWI V2 ZIP Recovery Integration Report
key_findings: Educational package is a clean superset of Multiplatform; 25 content-identical files.
Device package correctly fails closed on missing human auth, authority, device mismatch, etc.
Firefly original evidence already records independent_reproduction=NOT_ESTABLISHED and production_authorization=NOT_GRANTED.
Package-isolated tests: Educational 20/20 PASS, Multiplatform 13/13 PASS.
Small independent Firefly replay (100 tx) PASS and still refuses production claims.
No files from these archives collide with or replace swi_v2/kernel/governing_permit.py or the authorization spine.
Full main-repository pytest baseline NOT_RUN in this turn.
limitations: Full independent reproduction of the original 100k-transaction Firefly run was not performed.
No cryptographic device attestation beyond fingerprint strings is present in the device package.
Demonstration packages must not be mistaken for the live SWI V2 execution corridor.
relocation_policy: Original archives preserved under Local Independent Tests/. Extracted research copies may be placed under clearly labelled research/demo paths. No promotion into production packages.
